What This Is

US Guiding and Establishing National Innovation for US Stablecoins Act providing federal oversight framework for payment stablecoins..

Pilot deployments and early-stage commercial testing underway. Technology is proven at small scale. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

US GENIUS Act alongside EU MiCA creating dual regulatory framework for stablecoin issuance and oversight. Accenture Banking Trends 2026.
